title: Commissioner's waiver of a 105 CMR 700.000 requirement
rule_summary: The Commissioner may issue a waiver of one or more of the requirements imposed through 105 CMR 700.000 upon a finding that compliance would cause undue hardship to the registrant; that the registrant's noncompliance does not jeopardize the health or safety of individuals or the public; that the registrant has instituted compensating measures that are acceptable to the Commissioner; and that the registrant provides to the Commissioner, or their designee, written documentation supporting its request for a waiver.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate knows that a requirement in 105 CMR 700.000 that states no exception of its own is still reachable by the Commissioner's waiver, on stated findings.

authority.name: Waiver of requirements imposed on registrants

common_confusions: The waiver is available to a registrant of the Department; it is not a general dispensation for anyone bound by a similar rule from another source.
verification_notes: Read in the official 105 CMR 700.140 text published at mass.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
